tabLock.knownAge: {tab} research opens at server age {days} days. Yours is {yours}.

nodeCard.placeholder: Placeholder. Cost and bonus are empty in the package.

queuesStrip.title: Research queues
queuesStrip.note: Growth, Economy and Battle share one queue. T11 and T12 use the War Academy queue.
queuesStrip.idle: One research at a time. Press Start upgrade to begin one.

massSet.title: Mass set, {tab}
massSet.description: Pick a node and a level. Everything before it in the tree goes to max.
massSet.nothingChanges: Nothing changes. Every node here is already at or above this.
massSet.alreadyMax: {count, plural, one {{amount} earlier node is} other {{amount} earlier nodes are}} already at max and stay as they are. Nodes later in the tree are not touched. A level that is already higher stays.
massSet.blockersTitle: Some nodes need a building first.
massSet.blockers: {list}{more}. Pick an earlier node or raise the building on the Buildings page.
massSet.footnote: Mass set changes the saved levels of this tab only. It never lowers a level. Goals are not changed.

placeholder.title: Placeholder
placeholder.description: This node has no cost and no bonus in the package yet. Research time and cost show Unknown.

upcoming.shaded: Shaded rows are the levels between your level and your goal.

total.title: Total to your goal, level {level} to {goal}
total.missingTimes: {count, plural, one {{amount} level has} other {{amount} levels have}} no time in the package and count as 0 here.

plan.title: Plan Research
plan.description: Resources, time and power from current level to goal
plan.noGoals: No goals yet. Add a research node above, then pick the level you want it to reach.
plan.goalsHint: The current level is the one on the page. Change it there. Goals are read only on the page and are set here.
plan.failed: The plan could not be worked out.
plan.timeNote: The plan takes {time} after the {percent}% speed bonus. Your stock: Research {research} min, General {general} min. General speedups count toward research.

add.title: Add a research node
add.none: Every node is already in the plan or at its top level.

speed.title: Research speed
speed.carriedOver: Carried over from the Bonuses page.
speed.turnedOff: Turned off in Settings, under Apply my Bonuses totals.

result.title: Result, {steps} steps
result.stepsWithoutTime: {count, plural, one {{amount} step has} other {{amount} steps have}} no time in the package and count as 0 seconds.

export.empty: Add a goal to the plan to export it.
export.computed: Computed by the app from the plan result.

manage.finishText: Finish upgrade sets {name} to level {level}, frees the {queue} queue and adds the upgrade to your History. At zero time left the node and the queue card say Ready to finish. Nothing finishes by itself, because you may have used speedups.

cancelled.title: {name} research cancelled
cancelled.message: The level stays as it was. Fix your stock on Resources if needed.

stats.power: Research power, the power of every researched level
stats.withoutTimeNone: Without research time, every level has one
stats.withoutTimeSome: Without research time, shown as Unknown
stats.locked: Locked by server age or requirements

view.tabLockedNote: {reason} You can still set goals in Plan.
view.lockedByRequirement: {count} of {total} nodes in this tab are locked by a requirement.

search.label: Search nodes
search.placeholder: Search nodes by name or bonus

status.tree: {count} nodes in the {tab} tree. Research power in this tab: {power}. Scroll to pan. Nodes that do not match the search or filters are dimmed.
status.grid: Showing {shown} of {count} {tab} nodes. Research power in this tab: {power}. Goals are read only here and are set in Plan.

empty.title: No nodes match
empty.description: Change the search or reset the filters to see every node.

start.selectHelp: Only research you can start now is listed. Locked, maxed and running research is left out. A Growth, Economy or Battle research uses the Research queue. A T11 or T12 research uses the War Academy queue.
start.slotHelp: One research at a time in each queue. When the queue is busy this card says when it frees.
